basis: Primary-source evidence captured for Political MAYHEM competition registration. These snapshots preserve source state and discovery time; they do not create or alter a prediction.

snapshots.source_name: Parliament of NSW — Rules of the House
snapshots.captured_representation: Parliament of NSW Rules of the House states the current Sessional Orders are for the 58th Parliament.
snapshots.notes: Primary parliamentary evidence identifying the current NSW parliamentary term for competition-cycle registration.

snapshots.captured_representation: Parliament of NSW Bill Details for Abortion Law Reform Amendment (Sex Selection Prohibition) Bill 2025 records a private bill originating in the Legislative Council, status Second Reading, Debate adjourned, Wed 24 June 2026, member with carriage The Hon. John Ruddick, and Legislative Council amendments LP c2026-188A and Lawrence c2026-204C.
snapshots.notes: Primary parliamentary evidence for measure identity, current stage, carriage and material amendment resistance. A lodged amendment proves an altering position; it does not by itself prove outright opposition to the bill.

snapshots.captured_representation: Parliament of Australia Disallowance Alert 2026 records Carbon Credits (Carbon Farming Initiative—Improved Forest Management in Multiple-use Public Native Forests) Methodology Determination 2026 [F2026L00835]: Senator Cadell gave notice on 30 June 2026 and Mr Tehan gave notice on 30 June 2026 to disallow the instrument; both entries are unresolved.
snapshots.notes: Primary parliamentary evidence of an unresolved procedural contest seeking disallowance of an in-force instrument.

snapshots.captured_representation: Federal Register of Legislation records Carbon Credits (Carbon Farming Initiative—Improved Forest Management in Multiple-use Public Native Forests) Methodology Determination 2026 [F2026L00835] as in force, latest version 26 June 2026, administered by the Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water.
snapshots.notes: Primary legislation evidence for the procedural contest object and the status quo being defended against disallowance.
